scope: HERO forward only. This stage reads V and frozen forward center logits ONLY on explicit post-selection release for native FIT and RULE. No TUNE, E, I, test interior, archive, prior operator, or test labels. Forecast owner alone handles the later boundary gate and assessment. No post-gate changes or runner-up.
one_teacher: Use the single TUNE-nominated arm/rung, ordered by integer training seed. D is the first min(1024,nominated training parents) FIT parents in their frozen ladder order, using all 64 anchors equally. All proposals are unimodal signed single-feature affine approximations, not new trained encoders. No new opportunities across arms, radii, rotations, seeds or contrasts.
category_alignment: At each point take softmax of raw four logits; hard symbol=argmax (first raw column on exact tie). On D reference seed = lowest numeric seed. Order its classes by decreasing hard frequency, breaking ties by decreasing mean soft probability then raw index (ties disclosed). Positive reference sector=first, negative=second; no search for a better pair. For every other seed, choose permutation maximizing D hard-symbol agreement with reference over 24 permutations. Break ties by maximizing mean soft dot product with reference then lexicographic raw indices. Never rotate/permute lattice sites to align codes. Freeze permutation, centers and scales before RULE. Compare the 1st-vs-2nd aligned raw-logit difference (a log probability ratio, invariant to additive row-dependent logit gauge); subtract its D mean and divide by its D population SD separately by seed; ensemble arithmetic mean with equal weights. Argmax is a distinct categorical deployment, not a quantization of that teacher or f.
repro_gate: At least 3 distinct paired seeds; in each seed D and RULE SD of raw contrast >=0.25 natural log-odds units, every hard class share >=0.02; on RULE all pairwise Pearson r>=0.60 and chance-corrected hard agreement (Cohen kappa)>=0.30. Simultaneous one-sided 95% Bonferroni parent delete-one t lower bound across the 2*number-of-pairs measures >0.40 for r and >0.10 for kappa. Publish agreements, correlations, class rates, argmax ties, shuffle-by-one-whole-parent null (no re-alignment) and fractions. Null is descriptive. SD zero gives zero standardized contrast and no stability permission. No fit/RULE overlap or parent-wise anchor weighting changes.

dictionary.axis: All offsets ordered (z,y,x), each in [-1,1]. Open edges only, oriented from negative toward positive coordinate when signed. No implicit minimization/reorientation. Proper cube rotations permute site, axis and sign; fixed non-invariant components are laboratory-frame components, not scalars.
dictionary.cost1: 81 named single-site V/A/B indicators, including origin; all three whole-cube species counts.
dictionary.cost2: Three center NN species counts; total occupied-occupied internal NN edges on 54 edges; total unlike AB edges; center energy 1[occupied]*(#occupied six neighbors-(3 for A,5 for B))^2; each axis occupied-occupied edge count. All conventional.
dictionary.cost3: For each positive axis, count oriented A->B edges minus B->A edges (directional conventional); count all straight A-vac-B lines minus B-vac-A lines along that axis (9 length-three lines). For each choice of plaquette normal count elementary squares having exactly one vacancy diagonal and two occupied sites on the complementary diagonal. Components are fixed; no best axis rotation after selection.
dictionary.cost4: Two maximum literal ternary site-agreement fractions (over all 24 proper cube rotations of normal and every phase) with ideal pure-A/pure-B zero-energy packing trial crystals, vacancy when r dot normal == phase mod p, all other sites respectively A/B. A: (1,1,1),p=3; B:(1,2,3),p=7. These are explicit template proxies, NOT identifications of historical Crystal3/Crystal5 phases. Each maximized score is proper-cubic invariant. Both conventional.

selection: Fit affine Y=a+b*x for every listed x on D only, with Y=the single continuous ensemble log-odds contrast. Score on all RULE parents by R²=1-MSE/Var_RULE(Y), independent unweighted parents then equal anchors. Nonconstant x on D only. Keep lowest cost within absolute 0.02 of best R²; ties: higher R², then ASCII feature key. Require selected RULE R²>=0.50 plus reproducibility gates. Archive ranking, D-only best R² explanatory association even on failure, and fitted formula. No failure fallback. If candidate passes, frozen f=sign(b)*(x-mean_FIT(x))/SD_FIT(x), population moments over ALL authorized FIT anchors; unit=one FIT SD in orientation increasing Y. x constant on FIT, b=0 or variance<1e-8 fails, no invented scale. Discrete-valued x yields discrete-valued f, not a four-symbol rate claim. Report residual variance under S and conventional projections; never call agreement physical success.
conventional_predictor: Compare central-only models with 2-fold even/odd parent-position cross-fitting on all FIT, measured on MSE for f; final model refit on all FIT. Conventional multivariate basis: full 27-site A and vacancy indicators, all cost1/2 features, all oriented unlike signed bond features, both cost4 templates; all nine oriented species-pair counts per positive axis; for each origin species indicators times a 0..6 one-hot NN occupied degree. Models: FIT intercept; conditional mean by predeclared S (unseen cell=FIT mean); OLS on all conventional features with intercept (centered covariance pseudoinverse threshold 1e-10 relative on eigenvalues); OLS followed by S-specific mean residual, unseen offset=0. Choose smallest out-of-fold MSE, ties <=1e-12 choose simpler priority in listed order. If f directly equals a signed standardized conventional dictionary member, use exact identity instead, define residual identically zero and label rediscovery. Nontrivial f with residual variance fraction <0.10 is packing-explained/insufficiently distinct; no exam. Report FIT within-S and residual variances, OOF errors and RULE held-apart checks. S= ((Nv//3)*8+NA//4)*8+Noccupied_edges//8, no halo.
physical_nomination: One symbolic choice only. FIT-trained/TUNE-calibrated measured forecasts predict this very same frozen f on disjoint RULE parents. RULE shared in symbolic selection: this is selection-conditional development evidence, not a confirmation. Require Var_FIT(f)>1e-8, residual fraction>=.10, m1-vs-m0 and m1-vs-inventory paired normalized MSE point>=.01 AND one-sided whole-parent 95% lower>0, residual m1-vs-m0 point>0 in original Var_FIT(f) units. No other rule on failure. Conventional rediscovery: still report its development boundary forecast comparisons, no exams. Only Main may open independent cold/transfer/hot if all gates pass. Cold/transfer criteria per forecast prereg.
baselines: Same-region hard controls: origin ternary site directly; composition=Nvac, coordination=occupied-occupied internal NN, crystal=maximum of the two named pure-template agreements, random affine fixed seed 71991 using standardized-independent normal weights on 54 A/vacancy indicators, random tanh 16 standardized-width hidden units and independent normal output. Non-site hard symbols threshold into four empirical FIT quartiles (inverse empirical CDF, equality in lower bin, no splitting ties). For matched-rate random control threshold at cumulative descending deployed marginal of winner on FIT; always report actual marginal/entropy; collapsed bins and site alphabet not concealed. All use the same trained critic opportunity.
controls: Before native release: synthetic finite ternary words only. Verify site/count/internal-edge conventions with hand-filled words and proper rotations, template phase membership, orientation reversal, common-shift and category permutation invariance on finite planted logits; track fit/RULE reproducibility, single-feature fit and exact zero residual for conventional planted count. Thresholds: analytic equalities to abs 1e-6 except float64 moments <=1e-8; conventional residual=0 exactly; planted fit and agreement >0.99. Run after public prereg commit; no simulated physical configurations. Independent trainer controls determine physical admission separately.
